_doc: Work package C (Rifts): endless rift tiers, keys with modifiers, the Rift Guardian, the atlas and the pinnacle boss. All numbers of src/sim/rift.ts live here.

unlock._doc: Rifts open after Mother Vesper falls on this difficulty (index into difficulty.json). The URL flag ?dev opens them for testing.

scaling._doc: Tier t: life = life of a monster at refLevel on refDifficulty x hpGrowth^(t-1) x (1 + hpLinear x (t-1)); damage the same with dmgGrowth/dmgLinear. Monster level (experience, gold, item level) = base + floor((t-1) x perTier), at most max. Resistances of the hero get resPenalty in every rift, like Nightmare.

run._doc: Kills fill the progress bar (points per rank: normal, champion, elite, boss). When it is full the Rift Guardian appears. Beating the timer upgrades the next key.

guardian._doc: Built from an act I monster, scaled up. Boss rank life x hpMult. Two telegraphed mechanics (warning circles the hero steps out of). Below enrageBelow life the mechanics come faster.

rewards._doc: The guardian always drops the next key: one tier higher if the timer was beaten, else the same tier or (lowerChance) one lower. Elites have a small key chance. Fragments open the pinnacle.

keys._doc: A key rolls 0-4 modifiers (countWeights). Each is a hazard with chance hazardShare, else a boon (at most maxBoons). Every risk point of the hazards adds rewardPerRisk to the run.

keyMods._doc: fx keys: monRes (per element, added fraction), eliteMult, monSpeed, monDmg, monHp, packSize (fractions); heroRes, heroBarrierRegen (points); qty, rarity, gold, xp, progress (percent); shrineMult, wretchMult (extra factors: 2 = three times as often).

elites.text: Extra elite packs (3x as many elites)

atlas._doc: One point for every pointEvery tiers cleared for the first time. Nodes in a column need the node above (one rank is enough). fx per rank, same keys as keyMods plus: guardianHp, elitePoints, timer (seconds), twinKey, fragChance (fractions), extraSlot, noBoons, rewardMult, guardianItems, doubleLeap. Respec costs gold per spent point.

twin.name: Second Lock
twin.text: 25% chance the guardian drops a second key

shard.name: Shard Sense
shard.text: +20% chance of a key fragment from guardians

seal.name: Sixth Seal
seal.text: Keys roll one more modifier, +20% item quantity

weather.name: Weathered
weather.text: +8% to all your resistances in rifts

fate.name: Tempting Fate
fate.text: New keys roll no boons, but hazards give double reward

leap.name: Leap of Faith
leap.text: Beat the timer by half: the next key is two tiers higher

pinnacle._doc: Every `every` tiers cleared opens a pinnacle fight. It costs `frags` key fragments. The boss uses the monster `boss` (phases in monsters.json) at the rift tier of the pinnacle, life x hpMult. Mythic uniques (items.json, pinnacle: true) only drop here: always on the first kill of a pinnacle, else mythicChance.

mythic._doc: Effects of the three mythic uniques (items.json, pinnacle: true), see src/sim/mythic.ts.
